audit.scope_note: Hosted catalog availability is not runtime-readiness proof. The hosted RFD4 entries are grouped in one matrix entry; this does not assert identical weight revisions.

weight_root_resolution.reason_unknown: CLI help and organizer docs expose the root contract and selector, not the resolved path. Environment values and weight files were not inspected.

her2_novel_training_record.documented_source: Chinery trastuzumab CDRH3 FACS screen, described as about 524000 variants
her2_novel_training_record.documented_recipe: Starting from the antibody checkpoint, train on high/low binder pairs and prefer the high binder
her2_novel_training_record.independent_split_or_sequence_manifest: not documented in the inspected organizer materials

nebius.availability_note: Catalog availability or enabled status is not runtime proof. Scientific schemas marked configured-native-dag-not-a-readiness-claim were retained as such. No model job was submitted.

japanfold.availability_note: Read-only model inventory; no prediction, design or embedding job was submitted. The selected catalog entries do not publish an RFD4 checkpoint hash.

models.availability_evidence: Cached image and --model her2-novel selector observed; no inference run
models.input: Annotated CIF or organizer HER2 YAML/structure input
models.output: Designed amino-acid sequence and structure; native RFD4 structural metrics
models.evaluation_use: Generate trastuzumab CDRH3 candidates; assess sequence novelty and structural plausibility separately from measured SPR, competition and Tm.
models.key_limit: No teacher probabilities/logits, embeddings, direct distillation task or independent fine-tune split documented.
sources: docker help for cached her2-novel image

availability_evidence.japanfold: listed as rfd4 with rfd4-binder and rfd4-scaffold protocols

input.nebius: Exactly one native annotated CIF artifact; chemical/x-cif, uncompressed, maximum 268435456 bytes

models.output: All-atom sequence-and-structure designs; JapanFold orders by requested chain count and retained motif, not confidence. Nebius declares portable completed result artifacts.
models.evaluation_use: Generic alternate generator or service comparison; no evidence that either service exposes the Apheris her2-novel checkpoint.
models.key_limit: No local Apheris checkpoint selector or import field in the selected service schemas; no hosted weight hash reported for JapanFold.

models.input: Protein or biomolecular complex input; MSA on by default
models.output: Predicted structure, PAE/PDE/contact confidence; no binding affinity
models.evaluation_use: Structural prediction only. Distinct from JapanFold rfd3, which is a generator.

models.input: Fab heavy and light chains with protein antigen; MSA on by default
models.output: Predicted complex structure and PAE/PDE/contact confidence; explicitly no affinity
models.evaluation_use: Antibody-specific structural diagnostic on matched controls and candidate complexes. The completed local 3-seed panel recovered 0-5/19 WT footprint positions and failed its prespecified 13/19 diagnostic.
models.key_limit: Catalog states performance is not uniform on hard targets; Protenix-v2 stack means shared model lineage with Protenix.

models.input: Native Protenix JSON jobs on the documented no-MSA lane
models.output: Predicted complex structure and structural confidence artifacts
models.evaluation_use: Matched structural diagnostics; compare against measured controls and do not treat confidence as KD.

models.role: antibody inverse folding and sequence scoring
models.input: PDB archive with antibody chain IDs and optional antigen chain ID
models.output: Sampled sequences and structure-conditioned residue log probabilities/scores
models.evaluation_use: Antibody sequence/backbone compatibility signal; not HER2 binding, KD or Tm.

models.availability_evidence: native endpoint listed available; readiness observed in serverless schema
models.evaluation_use: Sequence redesign only after selecting a trustworthy backbone; refold the changed sequence before interpreting the interface.

models.input: Wild-type complex PDB, partner chain sets and mutations in original PDB numbering
models.output: Predicted binding ΔΔG in kcal/mol and Monte Carlo sampling error
models.evaluation_use: Retrospective check against measured SPR variants; does not predict thermal ΔTm/Tm and is not experimental KD.

context_results.rf3_wt_footprint_recall: 14/19 with distorted target and strong/weak footprint and target-pair-ipTM reversal
